description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kamburugamuwa North, Weligama D/S Division, Matara District - Cad. Map No. 820069
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, owner names, title classifications, and encumbrances. The content is entirely focused on land ownership and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
